summaries.summary: In a March 25, 2026 Community Impact Q&A, Gill identified attracting new businesses and supporting existing ones as his top priority, proposing the creation of an Economic Development Committee and noting that sales tax revenue helps offset property taxes. He cited fire department funding costs and proper management of the utility fund — including maintaining infrastructure while keeping water rates reasonable — as the city's biggest challenges, and acknowledged Jersey Village's achievement of five out of six Texas Comptroller transparency stars while suggesting improvements in social media outreach and resident engagement. Gill, a Jersey Village resident since 2011 and U.S. Director of Sales at BioZone Scientific, listed his background working with city governments and global retail as relevant experience.
